result.line: Curator with no owned contracts on Base (just Safes); 48.9M USD TVL sits in Morpho vaults (0.38M), IPOR Fusion (6.25M, api.ipor.io) and Euler (~42M); the only keeper fn IPOR updateMarketsBalances (0xe9a2e778) reverts AccessManagedUnauthorized from a stranger, daily keeper 0x48d3...ac9a (EOA) pays own gas (~0.006 gwei, <bash.01) and receives 0 tokens; Morpho accrueInterest also reverts for strangers; fee flow is depositors -> curator, nothing pays callers
